description: Android activity class for displaying ad samples with multiple fragments, integrating AdMob ads and handling ad events.

classes.name: AdsCatalogActivity
classes.description: Main activity hosting a ViewPager with ad fragments.

classes.name: AdsCatalogActivity.PagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter managing fragments for each ad layout.

classes.name: AdsCatalogActivity.AdFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying individual ad layouts with ad view and status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up ViewPager and adapter.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, resets ViewPager to first page.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates new AdFragment with specified number argument.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes ad view, sets ad listener, loads ad.
